basic_info.description: Tucked behind a lush hedge, this fully detached 2-bedroom, 2-bath cottage is a private sanctuary wrapped in gardens on a rare double lot. Sunlight pours through skylights and custom wood windows, while pine-clad ceilings crown a living room that flows into the farmhouse kitchen with exposed shelving, tiled backsplash, and custom cabinetry. A formal dining room overlooks the landscaped gardensperfect for everyday living or entertaining. Two remodeled baths feature radiant floors, and one bedroom flexes as a media room, library, or guest space. Downstairs offers a large bonus office, storage, laundry, and a spacious garage/workshop. Outdoors, the charm continues: an automatic gated art driveway opens to cobblestone paths, a pergola, greenhouse, and lush gardens where city living meets country calm. Modern comforts include heating/AC, seismic upgrade  and sweeping views of Mount Diablo and the Bay. Just half a mile from BART, with easy freeway access, H-Mart, and a variety of nearby dining and retail. A hidden retreatloved, meticulously cared for, and ready for its next chapter.
